title: Hardship Additions to the Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief on Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The relief share of the early-closure late-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the borrower is in a Larkspur hardship plan. The plans are the borrower's Hardship Assistance Programs plans, read from the hardship plan records: each plan's status and program.

## Hardship programs and the share

When the borrower has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status under the Reduced Payment Plan or the Short-Term Payment Deferral, the payment-relief addition is added; when the borrower has none of those but has another Larkspur hardship plan in active status, the hardship addition; when the borrower has no Larkspur hardship plan in active status, nothing is added for hardship.

| Borrower's active Hardship Assistance Programs plans | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| a Reduced Payment Plan or a Short-Term Payment Deferral | payment-relief addition: 0.3 (30 percentage points) |
| another active plan only (for example a Disaster Relief Deferral or a Term Extension Modification) | hardship addition: 0.15 (15 percentage points) |
| none in active status | 0.0, nothing added |

The addition is added to the relief share, not to the relief amount.

## Cases (hypothetical borrowers)

A borrower with an active Short-Term Payment Deferral and an active Temporary Rate Reduction Plan takes the payment-relief addition of 30 percentage points. A borrower whose only active plan is a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit takes the hardship addition of 15 percentage points. A borrower whose Reduced Payment Plan is no longer active, with no other active plan, takes nothing.
